question: Recommend asset classes to invest when the USD currency is appreciated, and when it is depreciated
query: -- The question asks to recommend asset classes to invest when the USD currency is appreciated. -- The table contains the following fields: -- forex_usd_eur: The exchange rate between USD and EUR (FLOA). -- forex_usd_jpy: The exchange rate between USD and JPY (FLOA). -- crude_oil_price: The price per barrel of crude oil (FLOA). -- gold_price: The price per ounce of gold (FLOA). -- real_estate_index: An index of real estate prices (FLOA). -- consumer_confidence_index: An indicator of consumer optiomism (FLOA). -- consumer_spending: Total household expenditure (FLOA). -- corporate_profiits: Profits earned by corporations after taxes (FLOA). -- retail_sales: The total retail sales value (FLOA). -- venture_capital_funding: The amount of VC funding (FLOA). -- The USD currency appreciation is indicated by an increase in the value of USD against other currencies. -- When the USD is appreciated, asset classes that tend to perform well are: -- 1. Gold: Gold is often seen as a safe haven asset and tends to perform well when the USD is appreciated. -- 2. Real Estate: Real estate prices may increase when the USD is appreciated, as it can make US assets more attractive to foreign investors. -- 3. Stocks: US stocks may perform well when the USD is appreciated, as it can boost corporate profits. -- 4. Venture Capital: Venture capital funding may increase when the USD is appreciated, as it can make US companies more attractive to foreign investors. -- 5. Crude Oil: Crude oil prices may increase when the USD is appreciated, as it can make oil more expensive for foreign buyers.  SELECT   gold_price,   real_estate_index,   consumer_confidence_index,   consumer_spending,   corporate_profiits,   retail_sales,   venture_capital_funding FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50;
